how: We read the website of every New York City wedding planner listed on Lazo (234 listings, 188 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: officiants and proposal planners, a Houston planner with a White Plains listing, an Italy-only destination company, and decor and venue businesses that also sell coordination. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Full planning, partial or month-of? Ask what each tier includes in hours, meetings and vendor management.
Which NYC venues have you run a wedding at this year, and do you know their load-in windows, union rules and insurance requirements?
Who is on site on the day, you or an associate, and what is the backup plan if it rains on a rooftop or park ceremony?

picks.name: The Wedding Plan & Company
picks.blurb: Jacquelyn Aleece founded The Wedding Plan & Co. in Hoboken in 2012 after more than 25 years in events and hospitality that began at her grandfather's wedding venue. Senior planners handle 200-plus weddings a year across NYC, New Jersey and Los Angeles.

picks.name: Campbell Events
picks.blurb: Campbell Events is an Astoria team of inclusive New York wedding planners who say they bring calm and confidence to the process and are organized, detail-obsessed and fun to work with. Full service planning, design and coordination packages are described on the site.

picks.name: Stephanie Gatton Events
picks.blurb: Stephanie Gatton brings stage management and 15-plus years of live event work, including The Juilliard School and the Guggenheim, to wedding coordination. Services start at $3,500 and begin five weeks before the date; most couples invest $3,500 to $4,500.

picks.name: Envisioned Events by Suzette, LLC
picks.blurb: Suzette spent 25-plus years in HR and legal at firms like American Express and PwC, with a Cornell degree, before turning that precision to events. Envisioned Events offers full-service planning and design plus wedding management starting 60 days out, across NYC, NJ, Westchester and the Hudson Valley.

picks.name: Sonal J. Shah Event Consultants
picks.blurb: Sonal J. Shah Event Consultants has planned elegant Indian weddings and events for over 20 years from New York City, and the site notes the firm was named best planner by Brides. Built for couples navigating intricate cultural traditions.

picks.name: Ultimate USA Weddings
tags: Central Park and Top of the Rock
picks.blurb: Ultimate USA Weddings plans New York City elopements and small destination weddings at spots like Central Park's Bow Bridge and Ladies' Pavilion, Top of the Rock, 620 Loft & Garden and the Brooklyn Bridge. Same-sex weddings, vow renewals and proposals are all on the menu, with a how-to guide for getting married in NYC.

picks.name: Debra Thompson, Planning & Consulting LLC
picks.blurb: Debra Thompson started as an event planner at a Westchester country club and launched her own firm 14 years ago, with 25 years in the industry overall. Weddings by Debra, in Tuckahoe, holds the Professional Wedding Planner designation and offers planning and consulting tiers.

picks.name: The Event Of A Lifetime, Inc.
picks.blurb: Founded in 1995 and accredited by the Association of Bridal Consultants, The Event Of A Lifetime is Melisa Imberman's full-service planning company in Millwood. Weddings, mitzvahs and other celebrations across the greater metro area, with personal attention to each client.

picks.name: Wedding Wishes Planning Co. by Neha
picks.blurb: Neha founded Wedding Wishes Planning Co. to plan South Asian, multicultural, fusion and Indo-Caribbean weddings across New York and New Jersey, from multi-day celebrations to intimate events. Based in North Massapequa.

picks.name: Nimma Ovwori Weddings
picks.blurb: Nimma Ovwori Weddings in Somerset plans Nigerian, Ghanaian and multicultural weddings across New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania and Delaware with over 15 years of experience and a project-management approach. Packages for every planning stage are listed.

picks.name: Detailed Events by Lo
picks.blurb: Lo discovered planning during her own wedding and now offers full planning, partial planning and day-of coordination in New Jersey and New York City. Detailed Events by Lo's Classy Bride Package covers couples whose venue, menu and dress are already set.

picks.name: Eastman Events, LLC
picks.blurb: Caitlin Eastman studied journalism and worked at a catering company serving weddings before founding Eastman Events, a Holmdel planning and design studio. The style is stylish events with classic, timeless charm, with quality, simplicity and originality as the stated values.
